I am Dr. Ali Al-Sharif

Consultant Orthopedic & Joint Surgeon

A Saudi orthopedic surgeon with over 15 years of experience specializing in knee, shoulder injuries and joint replacement surgeries. He has worked in leading Saudi and British hospitals, performing over 2,000 successful surgeries. He believes that continuous education and patient-centered care are the foundation of true medicine.
